source.title: Larne Times, 4 May 1961, p. 9 ("Nomination day springs surprises in East Antrim")
source.publisher: Larne Times (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed: two nominations for the two seats; the only possible contests were Gardenmore and Central (Larne Times, 4 May 1961, p. 9), and Gardenmore was the only poll (Larne Times, 18 May 1961, p. 6)

note: Election of the ten Larne Borough councillors, two for each of the five wards, polled Wednesday 17 May 1961 in Gardenmore Ward only (Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1961, p. 10). Central was uncontested after W. S. McIlroy withdrew; Inver and Townparks had two nominations each; Curran had one, the other seat becoming a casual vacancy filled at a later election (Larne Times, 4, 11 and 25 May 1961). No party labels are printed for the unopposed members. Returned unopposed.
